title: OPLAZEY Optimized
description: A lightweight Minecraft modpack that improves performance, boosts FPS, and keeps the fabric experience.
body:
This modpack improves Minecraft performance and gameplay. It includes optimization mods that make the game run smoother, increase FPS, and enhance the overall experience without changing the original fabric feel.
